my.heading: My Bidding Requests
my.emptySubtitle: Paste a Mercari item link to submit your first bidding request
my.cancelConfirmNotBidYet: If no real bid has been placed yet, the deposit will be released immediately after cancelling.
my.cancelConfirmAlreadyBid: If a real bid has already been placed (bids cannot be withdrawn), cancelling only stops further bidding — the deposit stays held until the auction ends.
my.cancelSuccessHeld: Stopped bidding further. Since a real bid was already placed, the deposit will be released after the auction ends
my.cancelFailed: Cancel failed, please try again later

rules.heading: Bidding Rules
rules.irrevocable: Bids cannot be withdrawn once submitted
rules.bidDirectPrice: ⚠️ Mercari bidding differs from Yahoo: each bid amount directly becomes the current price (no proxy bidding). We raise bids in minimum necessary increments and never jump straight to your limit
rules.endTimeMayChange: The auction end time may be extended, or ended early by the seller
rules.payWithin24h: Winning bids are binding — payment must be completed within 24 hours, no cancellation
rules.forfeitOnDefault: If payment is not completed within 24 hours of winning, the deposit is forfeited and the item will be handled by this site
rules.depositShared: Multiple requests share the same deposit capacity
rules.priceWins: When multiple customers bid on the same item, the highest bid wins; ties go to whoever bid first
